observations: A large dark rounded form fills the center against a deep red-brown field; loose red scribble loops crowd the upper left corner and left edge.
A zigzag band of yellow and black runs along the upper right, echoed by a teal spiral in the lower right quadrant; thin light-blue arcing lines sweep across the mid-section.
A horizontal rectangular block sits left of center, packed with vertical black stripes and white-and-red oval shapes; magenta strokes and a teal base anchor the lower half.
reading: The dark central mass presses outward while the red scribble field around it stays loose and unresolved, creating a push-pull the eye keeps negotiating. The yellow zigzag crown and the teal spiral sit at opposite corners, offering two different kinds of rhythm—sharp and angular versus slow and winding. The striped rectangular block reads as a dense, almost mechanical interruption inside an otherwise fluid composition.
